intro: Today's headlines focus on Armenia's Nations League campaign and domestic political developments, alongside a regular update on Artsakh.

topics.title: Armenia draws with Latvia in Nations League
topics.text: The Armenian national football team played out a draw against Latvia in their latest Nations League fixture. Coverage includes a match summary and post-match comments from head coach Yeghishe Melikyan, who expressed dissatisfaction with the result, and player Alexander Mishiev, who described his debut as surreal.

topics.title: Pashinyan to visit Russia three times in December
topics.text: Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan is planning three visits to Russia in December, according to CivilNet. The trips come amid reports of growing ties between Armenia and the European Union, signaling a continued balancing act in foreign policy.

sources.title: Pashinyan plans three visits to Russia in December amid growing ties with EU

topics.title: New constitution to limit prime ministerial powers
topics.text: Armenia's Justice Minister has stated that the draft for a new constitution will remove certain "super-prime-ministerial" elements. The proposal aims to redistribute powers that were concentrated in the premiership under the current framework.

sources.title: Armenia’s new constitution to drop some “super-prime-ministerial” elements, justice minister says

topics.title: Hrayr Maroukhian Foundation joins European progressive network
topics.text: The Hrayr Maroukhian Foundation has had its membership approved by the Foundation for European Progressive Studies (FEPS). The affiliation links the Armenian organization to a wider network of European social democratic foundations.

sources.title: Hrayr Maroukhian Foundation’s Membership in the Foundation for European Progressive Studies Approved

topics.title: Weekly report on Artsakh situation published
topics.text: Oragark has released its regular weekly report covering the latest developments regarding Artsakh. The update provides a summary of the ongoing situation in the region.

topics.title: Feature highlights Armenian inventions and luxury auction
topics.text: A cultural feature lists five inventions and popularizations attributed to Armenians globally. Separately, a luxury auction is set to feature over 100 rare Louis Vuitton bags designed by artists such as Murakami, Kusama, and Frank Gehry, with values reaching up to $30,000.
